lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Kyrgyzstan and exported in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage). The dataset represents approximately 619.7 thousand mapped buildings with an average data age of 4 years, sourced from volunteered geographic information contributions.
